Authorized view in Contact Center Insights.

## Example Usage - Contact Center Insights Authorized View Basic


```hcl
resource "google_contact_center_insights_authorized_view_set" "set" {
  authorized_view_set_id = "tf-test-set-authorized-view"
  location               = "us-central1"
  display_name           = "My Authorized View Set"
}

resource "google_contact_center_insights_authorized_view" "default" {
  authorizedviewset   = google_contact_center_insights_authorized_view_set.set.authorized_view_set_id
  authorized_view_id  = "authorized-view"
  location            = "us-central1"
  display_name        = "My Authorized View"
  conversation_filter = "agent_id = \"1\""
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:


* `location` -
  (Required)
  Resource ID segment making up resource `name`. It identifies the resource within its parent collection as described in https://google.aip.dev/122.

* `authorizedviewset` -
  (Required)
  Resource ID segment making up resource `name`. It identifies the resource within its parent collection as described in https://google.aip.dev/122.

* `authorized_view_id` -
  (Required)
  A unique ID for the new AuthorizedView. This ID will become the final
  component of the AuthorizedView's resource name. If no ID is specified,
  a server-generated ID will be used.
  This value should be 4-64 characters and must match the regular
  expression `^[a-z]([a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?$`. See
  https://google.aip.dev/122#resource-id-segments


* `conversation_filter` -
  (Optional)
  A filter to reduce conversation results to a specific subset.
  The AuthorizedView's assigned permission (read/write) could be applied to
  the subset of conversations.
  If conversation_filter is empty, there is no restriction on the
  conversations that the AuthorizedView can access.
  Having *authorizedViews.get* access to the AuthorizedView means having the
  same read/write access to the Conversations (as well as
  metadata/annotations linked to the conversation) that this AuthorizedView
  has.

* `display_name` -
  (Optional)
  Display Name. Limit 64 characters.

* `project` - (Optional) The ID of the project in which the resource belongs.
    If it is not provided, the provider project is used.



## Attributes Reference

In addition to the arguments listed above, the following computed attributes are exported:

* `id` - an identifier for the resource with format `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/authorizedViewSets/{{authorizedviewset}}/authorizedViews/{{authorized_view_id}}`

* `create_time` -
  The time at which the authorized view was created.

* `name` -
  Identifier. The resource name of the AuthorizedView.
  Format:
  projects/{project}/locations/{location}/authorizedViewSets/{authorized_view_set}/authorizedViews/{authorized_view}

* `update_time` -
  The most recent time at which the authorized view was updated.

This resource provides the following

## Import


AuthorizedView can be imported using any of these accepted formats:

* `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/authorizedViewSets/{{authorizedviewset}}/authorizedViews/{{authorized_view_id}}`
* `{{project}}/{{location}}/{{authorizedviewset}}/{{authorized_view_id}}`
* `{{location}}/{{authorizedviewset}}/{{authorized_view_id}}`

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, use an [`identity` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/identities) to import AuthorizedView using identity values. For example:

```tf
import {
  identity = {
    location = "<-required value->"
    authorizedviewset = "<-required value->"
    authorizedViewId = "<-required value->"
    project = "<-optional value->"
  }
  to = google_contact_center_insights_authorized_view.default
}
```

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import AuthorizedView using one of the formats above. For example:

```tf
import {
  id = "projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/authorizedViewSets/{{authorizedviewset}}/authorizedViews/{{authorized_view_id}}"
  to = google_contact_center_insights_authorized_view.default
}
```

When using the [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import), AuthorizedView can be imported using one of the formats above. For example:

```
$ terraform import google_contact_center_insights_authorized_view.default projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/authorizedViewSets/{{authorizedviewset}}/authorizedViews/{{authorized_view_id}}
$ terraform import google_contact_center_insights_authorized_view.default {{project}}/{{location}}/{{authorizedviewset}}/{{authorized_view_id}}
$ terraform import google_contact_center_insights_authorized_view.default {{location}}/{{authorizedviewset}}/{{authorized_view_id}}
```
